findings.scenario: S21 (ask determinism) — skeptic drove a bare metric follow-up
findings.observed: a bare metric query with a pool in CONTEXT (e.g. 'tvl trend' while viewing aave-v3 USDC) failed to resolve to the current pool -> an honest but unhelpful 'not found', instead of answering about the viewed strategy
findings.rootCause: the DATA_QUERY branch carried the leftover metric word ('trend') as an unresolved poolTerm, which blocked the context fallback (the withCtx helper only applies context when there is no poolTerm). A metric word is not a strategy name.
findings.fix: the DATA_QUERY branch now PREFERS the context pool when the fragment does not resolve to a recorded strategy (a leftover metric word never blocks the follow-up); a genuinely NAMED-but-unresolved strategy still returns an honest 'not found'. No fact moved; the groundedness gate + verdict guard unchanged.
findings.retest: the context follow-up resolves ('tvl trend' + context -> the pool's TVL row); an unknown-named metric with no context still says 'not found'; ask_router + ask_tools + ask_ui green; two consecutive clean runs identical

findings.scenario: S19/S21 (ask groundedness) — the PRISTINE fresh-clone run + a skeptic probe
findings.observed: TWO issues surfaced together: (a) a red-team test hardcoded the aave verdict as SOLID, which is UNVERIFIED on a fresh clone (the gitignored payloads absent -> SAMPLE), failing pristine 582/1; (b) probing that revealed the verdict guard was CASE-SENSITIVE, so a lowercase gap-fill ('aave looks solid') for an UNVERIFIED pool slipped the gate -> an ungrounded AI claim could render
findings.rootCause: the verdict guard matched only UPPERCASE verdict tokens, so a lowercase assertion/gap-fill was not caught; and a test asserted a record-dependent verdict that is honestly UNVERIFIED on a clone
findings.fix: the verdict guard is now CASE-INSENSITIVE and NEGATION-AWARE — a lowercase 'looks solid' for an UNVERIFIED pool is rejected (a gap-fill), while an honest disclaimer ('NOT the scorecard's SOLID', 'never a GO') passes; the clone-fragile assertions were made clone-robust (assert the injection is rejected + the deterministic text stands, not a hardcoded verdict). No fact moved; the groundedness verifier unchanged.
findings.retest: a lowercase gap-fill for an UNVERIFIED pool -> rejected; a negated disclaimer -> accepted; the full battery green in the working env AND on a pristine fresh clone (SAMPLE path); two consecutive clean runs identical
